scanNote:
11-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (77-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Our Precious Planet' va QIZIL yorliqda oq '11'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Reading'.
5) 'Read what each person says and answer the questions, then explain the words in bold.'
   UCh BOLA SURATI va GAP PUFAKChALARI:
   1 Roberta - Italy (sariq sochli qiz): 'If I were LEADER of my country, I would BAN cars because they cause too much AIR POLLUTION. I hate it when I'm riding my bike in the street and I can HARDLY breathe because of the traffic fumes. It makes me feel really ill. Air pollution causes acid rain, too, which kills trees and plants. I would also improve public transport. People wouldn't need to use their cars so much then. I think people should walk more often, or use a bicycle, like me! If they did, our cities would be HEALTHIER places to live in.'
   2 James - Kenya (qora tanli bola): 'If I were the leader of my country, I wouldn't allow hunters to kill endangered species. Did you know that animals such as tigers and rhinos have been HUNTED so much that there will soon be NONE left? I think we need to teach hunters that it's wrong to kill these animals. I would also CREATE special parks where these animals could live SAFELY.'
   3 Maria - Brazil (o'rilgan sochli qiz): 'If I were the leader of my country, I would stop logging companies from destroying the rainforest. It's terrible the way that animals and RARE plants die when the trees disappear. Don't these companies know that they're not just destroying the trees and the wildlife? They could destroy us all! Trees PRODUCE OXYGEN, which is one of our most BASIC NEEDS. One answer to the problem is to make the logging companies plant new trees. If they did that, it could save the rainforest and give all of us cleaner air to BREATHE.'
   SAVOLLAR (ko'k quti): 1 Why can Roberta hardly breathe when she's riding her bike? 2 What does acid rain kill? 3 What would happen if public transport were better? 4 What will happen if hunters continue to kill endangered species? 5 What happens when trees disappear? 6 What do trees produce? Why is it important to us?
• Katta to'q sariq 'Language Development'.
6) 'Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Qiya: basic, rare, ban, acid, logging, safely, plant, air, cleaner, species, public, traffic. 1 to ... cars 2 ... pollution 3 ... fumes 4 ... rain 5 ... transport 6 ... companies | 7 ... plants 8 to ... trees 9 ... air 10 endangered ... 11 ... needs 12 to live ...
7) 'Fill in the correct word from the list.' Qiya: created, breathe, improve, destroys, causes, hunt. 1 Having more buses would ...... public transport in cities. 2 Heavy traffic ...... a lot of air pollution. (O'NG USTUNDA:) 3 If we ...... more parks in our cities, they would be nicer places to live in. 4 It's so polluted I can't ...... properly. 5 Many people ...... endangered species for their fur. 6 Acid rain ...... plants.

O'NG USTUN:
8) 'Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' 1 because ...... sth; 2 to live ...... a city; 3 to stop sb ...... doing sth; 4 an answer ...... the problem
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Read the texts in Ex. 5 again and make notes under the following headings for each person. Use your notes to talk about each child's opinion.' Ko'k: Measures - Reasons - Results

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '77'.

exercises.instructionUz: Har bir odam nima deyishini o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh BOLANING FIKRI - TO'LIQ MATN VA
TARJIMA.


⚠ 11-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI - 2-TUR ShART:

  'If I WERE leader, I WOULD ban
   cars.'
  ⚠ 'If I WERE' - rasmiy shakl
  ('was' ham bo'ladi).
  ⚠ Xayoliy vaziyat: ular rahbar
  EMAS.

  'If they DID, our cities WOULD BE
   healthier.'
  'If they DID that, it COULD save
   the rainforest.'


⚠ 'HARDLY':

  = deyarli ... EMAS.
  ⚠ 'I can hardly breathe' = deyarli
  nafas ololmayman.
  ⚠ 'hard' (qattiq) bilan
  ADAShTIRMANG! 'hardly' = 'qattiq'
  EMAS.

points.en: [1 Roberta - Italy] If I were leader of my country, I would ban cars because they cause too much air pollution. I hate it when I'm riding my bike in the street and I can hardly breathe because of the traffic fumes. It makes me feel really ill.
points.uz: [1 Roberta - Italiya] Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, mashinalarni taqiqlardim, chunki ular juda ko'p havo ifloslanishiga sabab bo'ladi. Ko'chada velosiped haydayotganimda transport tutuni tufayli deyarli nafas ololmasligimni yomon ko'raman. Bu meni haqiqatan kasal his qildiradi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'If I WERE ... I WOULD ban' - 2-tur shart.
⚠ 'hardly' = deyarli ... emas.
⚠ 'because OF' + ot.

points.en: Air pollution causes acid rain, too, which kills trees and plants. I would also improve public transport. People wouldn't need to use their cars so much then. I think people should walk more often, or use a bicycle, like me! If they did, our cities would be healthier places to live in.
points.uz: Havo ifloslanishi kislotali yomg'irga ham sabab bo'ladi, u daraxt va o'simliklarni o'ldiradi. Men jamoat transportini ham yaxshilardim. Unda odamlar mashinalarini shunchalik ko'p ishlatishi kerak bo'lmasdi. Menimcha, odamlar men kabi ko'proq piyoda yurishi yoki velosiped ishlatishi kerak! Agar shunday qilsalar, shaharlarimiz yashash uchun sog'lomroq joylar bo'lardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'which kills' - nisbiy olmosh (11-unit).
⚠ 'If they DID, ... WOULD BE' - 2-tur shart.
⚠ 'healthier' = sog'lomroq.

points.en: [2 James - Kenya] If I were the leader of my country, I wouldn't allow hunters to kill endangered species. Did you know that animals such as tigers and rhinos have been hunted so much that there will soon be none left?
points.uz: [2 James - Keniya] Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, ovchilarga xavf ostidagi turlarni o'ldirishga ruxsat bermasdim. Yo'lbars va karkidon kabi hayvonlar shunchalik ko'p ovlanganki, tez orada birontasi ham qolmasligini bilarmidingiz?
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'have been hunted' - present perfect majhul.
⚠ 'none left' = hech biri qolmagan.
⚠ 'such as' = kabi, masalan.

points.en: I think we need to teach hunters that it's wrong to kill these animals. I would also create special parks where these animals could live safely.
points.uz: Menimcha, biz ovchilarga bu hayvonlarni o'ldirish noto'g'riligini o'rgatishimiz kerak. Men bu hayvonlar xavfsiz yashashi mumkin bo'lgan maxsus parklar ham yaratardim.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'where these animals could live' - nisbiy
olmosh 'where'.
⚠ 'safely' = xavfsiz (ravish).

points.en: [3 Maria - Brazil] If I were the leader of my country, I would stop logging companies from destroying the rainforest. It's terrible the way that animals and rare plants die when the trees disappear. Don't these companies know that they're not just destroying the trees and the wildlife? They could destroy us all!
points.uz: [3 Maria - Braziliya] Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, yog'och kompaniyalarini tropik o'rmonni vayron qilishdan to'xtatardim. Daraxtlar yo'qolganda hayvonlar va noyob o'simliklar o'lishi dahshatli. Bu kompaniyalar faqat daraxt va yovvoyi tabiatni emas, hammamizni vayron qilishi mumkinligini bilmaydimi?
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'stop sb FROM doing' = ... dan to'xtatmoq.
⚠ 'rare' = noyob, kam uchraydigan.
⚠ "Don't these companies know ...?" - inkor
savol (hayrat).

points.en: Trees produce oxygen, which is one of our most basic needs. One answer to the problem is to make the logging companies plant new trees. If they did that, it could save the rainforest and give all of us cleaner air to breathe.
points.uz: Daraxtlar kislorod ishlab chiqaradi, bu bizning eng asosiy ehtiyojlarimizdan biri. Muammoning bir yechimi - yog'och kompaniyalarini yangi daraxt ekishga majburlash. Agar shunday qilsalar, bu tropik o'rmonni saqlab qolishi va hammamizga nafas olish uchun tozaroq havo berishi mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'oxygen' /ˈɒksɪdʒən/ = kislorod.
⚠ 'basic needs' = asosiy ehtiyojlar.
⚠ 'make sb do' - 'to' siz.
⚠ 'to breathe' /briːð/ = nafas olmoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI SAVOL - JAVOBLAR MATNLARDA.

⚠ 3-SAVOL - 2-TUR ShART:
  'What WOULD happen if public
   transport WERE better?'
  ⚠ Javob ham 'would' bilan.

⚠ 4-SAVOL - 1-TUR ShART:
  'What WILL happen if hunters
   CONTINUE?' - real ehtimol.

items.en: 1 Why can Roberta hardly breathe when she's riding her bike?
items.uz: 1 Nega Roberta velosiped haydaganda deyarli nafas ololmaydi?

items.en: 3 What would happen if public transport were better?
items.uz: 3 Jamoat transporti yaxshiroq bo'lsa nima bo'lardi?
items.answerEn: People wouldn't need to use their cars so much.
items.answerUz: Odamlar mashinalarini shunchalik ko'p ishlatishi kerak bo'lmasdi.

items.en: 4 What will happen if hunters continue to kill endangered species?
items.uz: 4 Agar ovchilar xavf ostidagi turlarni o'ldirishda davom etsa nima bo'ladi?
items.answerEn: There will soon be none left.

items.en: 6 What do trees produce? Why is it important to us?
items.uz: 6 Daraxtlar nima ishlab chiqaradi? Nega bu biz uchun muhim?
items.answerEn: Trees produce oxygen. It is one of our most basic needs - we need it to breathe.
items.answerUz: Daraxtlar kislorod ishlab chiqaradi. Bu eng asosiy ehtiyojlarimizdan biri - nafas olish uchun kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Then explain the words in bold.

points.noteUz:
⚠ 'hard' (qattiq) EMAS!
⚠ 'I can hardly breathe' = deyarli nafas
ololmayman.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA MATNLARDA BOR:

  to BAN cars
  AIR pollution
  TRAFFIC fumes
  ACID rain
  PUBLIC transport
  LOGGING companies
  RARE plants
  to PLANT trees
  CLEANER air
  endangered SPECIES
  BASIC needs
  to live SAFELY


⚠ 'TO PLANT' va 'A PLANT':

  to plant = ekmoq (fe'l)
  a plant = o'simlik (ot)
  ⚠ 7-bandda 'rare PLANTS' (ot),
  8-bandda 'to PLANT trees' (fe'l).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct word from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 would IMPROVE public transport
  2 Heavy traffic CAUSES a lot of
    air pollution
  3 If we CREATED more parks
    (2-tur shart - past simple)
  4 I can't BREATHE properly
  5 Many people HUNT endangered
    species for their fur
  6 Acid rain DESTROYS plants


⚠ 'HEAVY TRAFFIC':

  = tirband transport.
  ⚠ 'heavy' bu yerda = ko'p, zich.


⚠ 'FUR':

  = mo'yna.
  ⚠ 'for their fur' = mo'ynasi uchun.


⚠ 'PROPERLY':

  = to'g'ri, yaxshilab.


⚠ 'HAVING MORE BUSES':

  - gerund ega vazifasida.

items.sentence: Having more buses would ___ public transport in cities.
items.uz: Ko'proq avtobus bo'lishi shaharlardagi jamoat transportini yaxshilardi.

items.sentence: Heavy traffic ___ a lot of air pollution.
items.uz: Tirband transport ko'p havo ifloslanishiga sabab bo'ladi.

items.sentence: If we ___ more parks in our cities, they would be nicer places to live in.
items.uz: Agar shaharlarimizda ko'proq park yaratsak, ular yashash uchun yoqimliroq joylar bo'lardi.

items.sentence: It's so polluted I can't ___ properly.
Many people ___ endangered species for their fur.
items.uz: Ko'p odamlar xavf ostidagi turlarni mo'ynasi uchun ovlaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predlogni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR:

  because OF sth
  to live IN a city
  to stop sb FROM doing sth
  an answer TO the problem


⚠ 'BECAUSE' va 'BECAUSE OF':

  because + GAP: 'because they cause
     pollution'
  because OF + OT: 'because of the
     traffic fumes'


⚠ 'AN ANSWER TO':

  = ... ga javob/yechim.
  ⚠ 'answer TO' - 'of' EMAS.

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'because OF' + ot: 'because of the traffic
fumes'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts in Ex. 5 again and make notes under the following headings for each person. Use your notes to talk about each child's opinion: Measures - Reasons - Results
exercises.instructionUz: 5-mashqdagi matnlarni qayta o'qing va har bir odam uchun quyidagi sarlavhalar ostida qayd oling. Qaydlaringizdan foydalanib har bir bolaning fikri haqida gapiring: Choralar - Sabablar - Natijalar
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYDLAR:

  ROBERTA:
    Measures: ban cars, improve public
      transport
    Reasons: air pollution, can't
      breathe, acid rain
    Results: healthier cities

  JAMES:
    Measures: not allow hunters,
      create special parks
    Reasons: tigers and rhinos hunted,
      soon none left
    Results: animals live safely

  MARIA:
    Measures: stop logging companies,
      make them plant trees
    Reasons: animals and rare plants
      die, trees produce oxygen
    Results: save rainforest, cleaner
      air


⚠ 'A MEASURE':

  = chora, tadbir.
  ⚠ 'to take measures' = chora
  ko'rmoq.
exercises.exampleEn: Roberta would ban cars and improve public transport because cars cause air pollution and acid rain. As a result, cities would be healthier.
exercises.exampleUz: Roberta mashinalarni taqiqlab, jamoat transportini yaxshilardi, chunki mashinalar havo ifloslanishi va kislotali yomg'irga sabab bo'ladi. Natijada shaharlar sog'lomroq bo'lardi.
modelAnswers: Roberta would ban cars and improve public transport because cars cause air pollution and acid rain. As a result, cities would be healthier.

James wouldn't allow hunters to kill endangered species and would create special parks because tigers and rhinos have been hunted so much that there will soon be none left. As a result, animals could live safely.

Maria would stop logging companies from destroying the rainforest and make them plant new trees because animals and rare plants die when trees disappear and trees produce oxygen. As a result, the rainforest would be saved and we would have cleaner air.
modelAnswersUz: Roberta mashinalarni taqiqlab, jamoat transportini yaxshilardi, chunki mashinalar havo ifloslanishi va kislotali yomg'irga sabab bo'ladi. Natijada shaharlar sog'lomroq bo'lardi.

James ovchilarga xavf ostidagi turlarni o'ldirishga ruxsat bermasdi va maxsus parklar yaratardi, chunki yo'lbars va karkidonlar shunchalik ko'p ovlanganki, tez orada birontasi qolmaydi. Natijada hayvonlar xavfsiz yashay olardi.

Maria yog'och kompaniyalarini o'rmonni vayron qilishdan to'xtatib, ularni yangi daraxt ekishga majburlardi, chunki daraxtlar yo'qolganda hayvonlar va noyob o'simliklar o'ladi va daraxtlar kislorod ishlab chiqaradi. Natijada tropik o'rmon saqlanib qolardi va havomiz tozaroq bo'lardi.

patterns.formula: If I were leader of my country, I would / wouldn't + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: If I were leader of my country, I would ban cars.
patterns.exampleUz: Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, mashinalarni taqiqlardim.

patterns.formula: I can hardly + FE'L because of [ot].
patterns.exampleEn: I can hardly breathe because of the traffic fumes.
patterns.exampleUz: Transport tutuni tufayli deyarli nafas ololmayman.

patterns.exampleEn: I would stop logging companies from destroying the rainforest.
patterns.exampleUz: Yog'och kompaniyalarini o'rmonni vayron qilishdan to'xtatardim.

patterns.formula: One answer to the problem is to make [kim] + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: One answer to the problem is to make the logging companies plant new trees.
patterns.exampleUz: Muammoning bir yechimi - yog'och kompaniyalarini yangi daraxt ekishga majburlash.
